message: The other night, we had a power outage that lasted longer than expected. At first, I felt a bit lost without my usual gadgets and comforts. But then, I pulled out the old board games and a couple of flashlights, and we ended up having a wonderful time just chatting and playing. It was a refreshing reminder that low-tech fun can be just as delightful! How do you keep the good times rolling when the lights go out?
